title: A gym link or code that finds no gym leaves the member with nobody to ask
what: When a join or check-in link, or a typed gym code, matches no gym, the page offers only Scan the poster and Type a gym code (or Close). If the gym has left MettleUp or its code changed, the poster and old WhatsApp links will always land here, and the member has no way to tell MettleUp or anyone else.
expected: The page also gives one way to reach someone, for example a Tell MettleUp button or the gym's own contact, so a dead poster gets noticed and fixed.
how_often: every time a link or code finds no gym
fix_line: Add one contact button to the gym not found page

title: A member's Tell my gym lead reaches MettleUp with only a gym name and city
what: When no gym lists the member's number, the app says the MettleUp team may contact your gym if the member types its name and city. Only those two words are sent: no phone number, area or member count. Someone at MettleUp must find the gym by hand each time, and nothing alerts them a lead came in unless HQ is open.
expected: The lead carries enough to act on (for example the gym's area or phone, typed by the member if they wish), and the owner's daily list shows new member leads.
fix_line: Ask for one more optional detail and list member leads in HQ's daily work

items.reason: Set-up is the join link or code; leaving clears the kept plan, offer, reminders, diets and hours at once and resends the leave to the server later when offline; member billing is the gym's UPI or pay-online request. No data import or support window lives in this area. A gym that left MettleUp sends old links to the gym not found page, which has no contact.

The member app has no help articles for these screens; the words live on the screens. The admin help about member messages describes a 180-day delete that the message screens do not really do (already found).

Message your gym reaches the gym's owner, desk or trainers by kind, with a clear failed-send line and Try again. A complaint about the gym itself goes only to that gym's owner, and the app gives no MettleUp contact after joining (already found). The gym not found page reaches nobody.

Printed posters and shared join links still use the founder's personal domain and must keep working for good; no renewal record (already found). The WhatsApp business number comes from the server, not the app. No signing key or token is held in this area.
